service.en: Abu Dhabi Green Visa for skilled employees
service.ar: التأشيرة الخضراء في أبوظبي للموظفين المهرة

about: Five-year residence for skilled employees on a qualifying contract.
note: Requirements read from the official ADDED long-term residency page on the checked date. The visa itself is applied for through ICP, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Hold a work permit based on a UAE employment contract
Work in a MOHRE first, second or third skill level job
Hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent
Earn at least AED 15,000 a month
documents: Valid MOHRE employment contract showing job title and income
channels: Start with your employer's HR team
ADDED contact line 800555, 8 am to 3 pm, or contact@tamm.abudhabi
